title.zh: Bitcoin Falls Below $76,000 as Traders Cut CLARITY Act Odds Hours Before Senate Vote
title.en: Bitcoin Falls Below $76,000 as Traders Cut CLARITY Act Odds Hours Before Senate Vote

current_state.zh: Bitcoin fell below $76,000 as Polymarket odds of the CLARITY Act becoming law this year dropped from 29.5% to 12.5% hours before a Senate cloture vote, with 95 of the 124 largest non-stablecoin tokens declining as the Fed began a two-day meeting.
